open System
open System.IO
open System.Threading.Tasks
open Client
open Client.LedgerStore
open Client.ReviewWorkflow
open Client.NativeHealth
open Client.NativeHealth.NativeHealth
open Common.SignalR
open AutomationHealthHostedFixture
let run subscribed =
    let root = Path.Combine(Path.GetTempPath(), "jarvis-health-sidecar-proof-" + Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N"))
    Directory.CreateDirectory root |> ignore
    try
        let first, second, rt, _, candidate = create root
        if subscribed then
            let op = Guid.NewGuid()
            Client.ChallengeWorkflow.ChallengeWorkflow.setSubscription first op "Worker" true |> success |> ignore
            let _, receipt = LedgerStore.getOperationStatus first op |> success
            printfn "SUBSCRIPTION receipt=%A" (receipt |> Option.map (fun x -> x.Type))
        let snap = LedgerStore.fetch first |> success
        printfn "CASE subscribed=%b paths=%A" subscribed (LedgerStore.listAt first snap "agents" |> success)
        let observed = NativeHealth.enumerate rt
        printfn "ENUM=%A" (observed |> Result.map (List.map (fun x -> x.AgentId, x.TaskId)))
        let now = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow
        let idle : AgentActivitySnapshot = { ServerNowUtc = now; LastSeenAtUtc = Some(now.AddSeconds(-601.)) }
        let mutable calls = 0
        let deps : Dependencies =
            { Enumerate = fun () -> NativeHealth.enumerate rt
              Current = NativeHealth.current rt
              Activity = fun _ _ -> calls <- calls + 1; Task.FromResult(Ok idle)
              Recover = NativeHealth.recover rt }
        let result = NativeHealth.checkOnce {Enabled=true; InactivitySeconds=600} deps |> fun x -> x.GetAwaiter().GetResult()
        let _, receipt = LedgerStore.getOperationStatus second (NativeHealth.recoveryOperationId candidate) |> success
        let _, _, attempt = ReviewWorkflow.getTask second candidate.TaskId |> success
        printfn "RESULT candidates=%d holds=%d recoveries=%d errors=%A activityCalls=%d receipt=%A generation=%d->%d" result.Candidates result.Holds result.Recoveries result.Errors calls (receipt |> Option.map (fun x -> x.Type)) candidate.Generation attempt.Value.AssignmentGeneration
        if subscribed then
            if not (Result.isError observed && result.Candidates=0 && result.Holds=1 && result.Recoveries=0 && calls=0 && receipt.IsNone && attempt.Value.AssignmentGeneration=candidate.Generation) then failwith "Sidecar reproduction failed"
        else
            if not (Result.isOk observed && result.Candidates=1 && result.Recoveries=1 && calls=2 && receipt.IsSome && attempt.Value.AssignmentGeneration=candidate.Generation+1) then failwith "No-sidecar control failed"
    finally Directory.Delete(root,true)
[<EntryPoint>]
let main _ = run false; run true; 0
